resources.string: This shortcut opens Android\'s native radio information menu. This app does not change the network type; you must select LTE Only manually in that menu.
If you select LTE Only, your phone will not receive or make calls or send SMS. Before changing it, note the current preferred network type so you can restore it later.
Your original preferred network type may appear as “LTE/TD-SCDMA/UMTS” or “LTE/TD-SCDMA/WCDMA”. Write it down before selecting LTE Only and restore it when you are done.
Not all phones can open or use this tool. Availability depends on the brand and model; some manufacturers block access to this menu or network changes.
This phone does not allow opening the radio menu.
